text:
Jamal: tiny, weird request — trying to craft a 3-item 'queue kit' for the 90s you stand in line for coffee: pick 2 songs (exact tracks) you’d play and one single-page comic/illustrated zine/page to flip through while you wait. keep it short and evocative. :coffee:
Devin: easy — `Jon Hopkins - Open Eye Signal` then `Sufjan Stevens - Chicago (20 sec fade-in edit)` + a one-page minicomic from @sarah (her zines are perfect) — `Tiny City #2` :+1:
Max: ooh — I’d do `Broadcast - Come On Let's Go` then `Can - Vitamin C` (makes the line feel cinematic) + `The New Yorker single-panel 'MTA'` scan I keep in my wallet :grin:
Katie: love this. my queue kit = `Nina Simone - Feeling Good` (first 30s) then `Chaz Bundick - Honey` little loop + a single illustrated postcard from the 'Pocket Comics' series (artist: Emi Tanaka). brings a calm bubble. :heart:
Ara: if you want ambient: `William Basinski - dlp 1.1` (looped snippet) then `Loscil - First Narrows` (fade) + `one-page goth zine 'Noct'` — instant micro-cinematic waiting room.
soundbot: auto-suggest: "Shortwave Scores Pack" — [Track A] `Philip Glass - Metamorphosis One (0:00-0:55)`, [Track B] `Ryuichi Sakamoto - Bibo no Aozora (0:00-0:40)`, Companion: `Mini Panel: 'Transit' by K. Hsu (single-page)` — add to playlist? :robot_face:
Devin: vote with emoji — which vibe for the office espresso line? A: upbeat/driving :muscle:, B: mellow/ambient :dove:, C: vintage/surreal :sparkles:  (react with your pick)
Max: reacted :muscle:
Katie: reacted :dove:
Ara: reacted :sparkles:
Jamal: tally so far — A:1 B:1 C:1, haha. I’ll maybe randomize when making the playlist. thanks y’all, these are great — putting together a short 7-track 'queue-kit' on Spotify and printing a one-page zine list for the kitchen table. will drop link later. :coffee::headphones:
Katie: yes pls drop link — also willing to add a physical stack of single-page zines if someone wants to donate their extras. :raised_hands:
